lessons.title: Vocal Lineage — From Chaka to Whitney to Beyoncé

body.text: Beyoncé Goals: Show her influence tree explicitly. Chaka → Whitney Whitney’s debut single was literally a Chaka cover: “I’m Every Woman.” Chaka’s riffs, power, and phrasing hugely influenced Whitney. Whitney → Beyoncé Beyoncé’s runs, belts, and stage dominance show the Chaka lineage. Ask your son what they share: POWER + JOY + FEMININE STRENGTH.

finalProject.prompt: Explain how Chaka Khan redefined R&B and funk through her powerhouse vocals, band chemistry (Rufus), and feminist presence. Compare ONE Rufus track (‘Tell Me Something Good’ or ‘Sweet Thing’) with ONE solo track (‘I’m Every Woman’ or ‘Through the Fire’). Identify TWO modern artists who clearly reflect Chaka’s influence.
